question.problem:
Let $B=\{{b}_{1},{b}_{2},{b}_{3}\}$ be a basis of ${R}^{3}$ and let $S$ be the standard basis of ${R}^{3}.$ What are the values of $a,b,$ and $c$ if 

$$
{b}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -4 \\ 7\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 1 \\ 5\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 2 \\ 0\end{aligned}],
$$

and the change-of-coordinates matrix from $B$ to $S$ is 

$$
{P}_{B\to S}=[\begin{aligned}a & 3 & -1 \\ -4 & 1 & b \\ 7 & c & 0\end{aligned}].
$$

current_example.problem:
Let $\mathcal{B}=\{\mathbf{b}_1,\mathbf{b}_2,\mathbf{b}_3\}$ be a basis of $\mathbb{R}^3$ and let $\mathcal{S}$ be the standard basis of $\mathbb{R}^3.$ Find the values of $a,b,$ and $c$ if 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14275083/assets/2de66cf8e2fe6242a86d272fb067bd9386d54249d45675248e6e876c73b950e1.svg)

and the change-of-coordinates matrix from $\mathcal{B}$ to $\mathcal{S}$ is 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14275083/assets/77889c99b76586b4c72650ce2c6920263547b578530ee1086140c8d7306b79bd.svg)
current_example.worked_solution:
Recall  that the standard basis of $\mathbb{R}^3$ consists of the vectors $\mathbf e_1, \mathbf e_2,$ and $\mathbf e_3,$ given by
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14275083/assets/83439b6302d964406bad8cba8dd6e7eff374d7653f838657ff98fd855b8884c0.svg)

The components of the vectors in $\mathcal{B}$ are just the coordinates relative to the standard basis:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14275083/assets/6cd4ed5036a365748f89a5b279f824e406943fefc108b4c93cd97624772e427b.svg)

The change-of-coordinates matrix from $\mathcal{B}$ to $\mathcal{S}$ is a matrix whose respective columns are the coordinates of the vectors of $\mathcal{B}$ relative to the basis $\mathcal{S}.$ 

Therefore, we obtain
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14275083/assets/00a5f30cd6f11f46b338513d0e2a5c9cad7abfc3b203df66db9b8c07fead1c30.svg)

Finally, $a=0,$ $b=0,$ and $c=10.$
